questions.question: [Approaches and Perspectives] Explain how the biological and cognitive approaches differ in explaining depression
questions.correctAnswer: Biological: genetic predisposition, serotonin/noradrenaline deficit, hippocampal atrophy -> treatment: SSRIs, ECT. Cognitive: Beck's negative triad (self, world, future), cognitive distortions, schema -> treatment: CBT (challenge thoughts). Biological = reductionist, medical; Cognitive = mental proc

Cognitive: Beck's negative triad (self, world, future), cognitive distortions, schema -> treatment: CBT (challenge thoughts). Biological = reductionist, medical; Cognitive = mental proc

questions.question: [Memory and Cognitive Psychology] Explain how the Working Memory Model accounts for dual-task performance better than the Multi-Store Model
questions.correctAnswer: MSM: single STM store -> two verbal tasks interfere. WMM: separate stores (PL for verbal, VSSP for visual) -> can do verbal + visual simultaneously. Evidence: Baddeley (verbal reasoning + tracking). PL overload impairs both if both verbal

questions.question: [Psychopathology] Explain the two-process model of phobias and evaluate it

questions.question: [Research Methods] Design an experiment to test if caffeine improves reaction time. Identify IV, DV, design, controls, sampling, ethics
questions.correctAnswer: IV: caffeine (200mg vs placebo). DV: reaction time (ms) on computer task. Design: repeated measures (counterbalanced). Controls: same time of day, same task, blind. Sampling: volunteer students (opportunity). Ethics: consent, right to withdraw, debrief, medical screening for caffeine sensitivity

questions.question: [Social Influence and Attachment] Explain why Milgram's participants obeyed using agency theory
questions.correctAnswer: Agentic state: individual sees self as agent of authority, not responsible. Autonomous state: self-directed. Shift triggered by: legitimate authority, institutional context, gradual commitment (15V steps), buffers (victim not visible). Dispositional: authoritarian personality (Adorno)
